blocks.zh_text: 一夜之间消失。

blocks.en_text: He'll remain as chairman
blocks.zh_text: 他将留任董事长

blocks.en_text: and I think his influence will still be felt by the company.
blocks.zh_text: 我认为公司仍会感受到他的影响力。

blocks.en_text: He's a major shareholder of the firm
blocks.zh_text: 他是公司的大股东

blocks.en_text: and while he is slowly divesting that stake and giving it
blocks.zh_text: 虽然他正在慢慢减持这部分股份，把它

blocks.en_text: to his children's foundations,
blocks.zh_text: 捐给他子女的基金会，

blocks.en_text: I think his legacy will long be felt.
blocks.zh_text: 但我认为他的遗产将长久被人感受到。

blocks.en_text: But Abel will be taking over many of his duties,
blocks.zh_text: 但阿贝尔将接手他的许多职责，

blocks.en_text: including the writing
blocks.zh_text: 包括撰写

blocks.en_text: of Berkshire's annual letter to shareholders.
blocks.zh_text: 伯克希尔致股东的年度信。

blocks.en_text: This is a big change because Buffett fans have been
blocks.zh_text: 这是一个巨大的变化，因为巴菲特的粉丝们多年来

blocks.en_text: poring over that letter over the years
blocks.zh_text: 一直在仔细研读那封信

blocks.en_text: because it's full of witticisms, investment advice,
blocks.zh_text: 因为它充满了妙语、投资建议

blocks.en_text: pearls of wisdom.
blocks.zh_text: 和智慧结晶。

blocks.en_text: There's also the fact that he's not going to be taking Q&A
blocks.zh_text: 还有一点，他将不再在明年五月于奥马哈举行的

blocks.en_text: at the annual meeting next May in Omaha.
blocks.zh_text: 年度股东大会上回答提问。

blocks.en_text: Welcome to Berkshire Hathaway.
blocks.zh_text: 欢迎来到伯克希尔·哈撒韦。

blocks.en_text: He was talking for four to five hours every year
blocks.zh_text: 他每年都要讲四到五个小时

blocks.en_text: and taking questions from people
blocks.zh_text: 回答来自世界各地

blocks.en_text: that follow him all over the planet.
blocks.zh_text: 追随他的人的提问。

blocks.en_text: That is gonna be a big change
blocks.zh_text: 这将是一个巨大的变化

blocks.en_text: because Buffett's personality isn't matched in the
blocks.zh_text: 因为巴菲特的个性在投资界

blocks.en_text: investment world.
blocks.zh_text: 无人能及。
